output.fix: Make the client send code_challenge with code_challenge_method=S256 on every authorization request. It should generate a high-entropy code_verifier per request and send that verifier at the token endpoint. On the authorization server, require PKCE for this public client and reject authorization requests that have no code_challenge, and reject the plain method. Apply the same to confidential clients.

alternatives.why_not: No verifier or challenge was supplied, so that check was skipped. There is no evidence of a mismatch. The issue is that PKCE is absent.

questions: code_verifier (and code_challenge / code_challenge_method) if you want the verifier-to-challenge match checked
